description: The atmospheric component is based on ECHAM v6.3.02, originally developed by the Max Planck Institute for Meteorology and adapted within the NUIST Earth System Model (NESM; Cao et al., 2018). It employs a spectral dynamical core with triangular truncation at wavenumber 63 (T63) on an associated 192 x 96 Gaussian grid (~1.875 degree resolution) with 47 vertical hybrid sigma-pressure levels and a flux-form semi-Lagrangian scheme for tracer transport. Physical parameterizations include the RRTMG shortwave and longwave radiative transfer scheme, the Tiedtke-Nordeng mass-flux cumulus convection parameterization with convective momentum transport, a prognostic cloud microphysics and cloud cover scheme, turbulent vertical diffusion based on high-order closure, and subgrid-scale orographic gravity wave drag.
